Sir,
CPFC while reviewing
the disposal
of complaints
and grievances
in Vigilance
observed
that it takes at least one month
after receipt of complaint
to get the same
authenticated
from the complainant
and initiating
an action on the same, if required.
In order to ensure quick action and to resolve the grievance
of the complainant
at the
earliest, CPFC has directed
that Complainants/aggrieved
members
may be informed
to invariably
mention
their Mobile Number
and e-mail id on the complaints.
All the
field offices shall make suitable
arrangements
for the same by way of putting
Notice
